definitions.explanation: A mechanical fan used to remove stale air, smoke, or odors from a room.

examples.japanese: ⟦{料理|りょうり}→料理：01523_ryouri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{換気扇|かんきせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please turn on the exhaust fan when cooking.

examples.japanese: {換気扇|かんきせん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{油|あぶら}→油：01693_abura⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{汚|よご}れている→汚れる：01293_yogoreru⟧。
examples.english: The ventilation fan is dirty with grease.

examples.japanese: ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{換気扇|かんきせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}して→回す：01158_mawasu⟧⟦おく→おく：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: Leave the bathroom exhaust fan running.

notes:
{換気扇|かんきせん} is a compound: ⟦{換気|かんき}→換気：00172_kanki⟧ (ventilation) + ⟦{扇|せん}→扇：noentry⟧ (fan).

COMMON LOCATIONS:
- ⟦{台所|だいどころ}→台所：01021_daidokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{換気扇|かんきせん} (kitchen exhaust fan)
- ⟦{浴室|よくしつ}→浴室：05301_yokushitsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{換気扇|かんきせん} (bathroom exhaust fan)
- ⟦トイレ→トイレ：00818_toire⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{換気扇|かんきせん} (toilet exhaust fan)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {換気扇|かんきせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦つける→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧/⟦つけて→つける：00562_tsukeru⟧⟦おく→おく：01092_oku⟧ (to turn on the fan)
- {換気扇|かんきせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{回|まわ}す→回す：01158_mawasu⟧ (to run the fan)
- {換気扇|かんきせん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{掃除|そうじ}→掃除：02889_souji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to clean the fan)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Kitchen exhaust fans in Japan commonly get very greasy and require regular cleaning. Many people clean them during ⟦{大掃除|おおそうじ}→大掃除：08347_oosouji⟧ (year-end cleaning).
